Grants a low/mid/high-level might effect, which strengthens your body and mind to boost your attack power with all weapons.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can drink Mighty Elixirs to receive a boost to his attack power. This effect works by strengthening one's body and mind, and it applies to all [[Weapon]]s. Mighty Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Bladed Rhino Beetle]] By adding any of these mighty ingredients, Link can make a Mighty Elixir that will also heal him: * [[Mighty Bananas]] * [[Razorshroom]] * [[Mighty Thistle]] * [[Mighty Carp]] * [[Mighty Porgy]] * [[Razorclaw Crab]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Mighty Elixirs reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK }}
